Statement: Rigorous mammography benchmarking requires patient-clustered bootstrap 95% CIs, paired DeLong/McNemar or permutation tests with Holm-Bonferroni or BH-FDR multiplicity control, and fixed-sensitivity specificity reporting rather than 5-fold Wilcoxon alone.
